Healthy years lost for every 100 infections

harm_per_infection.Rd

Divides healthy years lost (DALYs) by the number of infections. The result shows how harmful one infection is, not how common it is.

Usage

harm_per_infection(data)

Arguments

data

A data frame with the same columns as hai_burden.

Value

A data frame with one row per survey sample and infection. The column dalys_per_100 is the number of healthy years lost for every 100 infections.

Examples

harm_per_infection(hai_burden)
